title: 2-D FIR Filter
text: 2-D FIR filter on input matrix, 5 inputs, 1 output, {Padding options} sets Padding method; {Separable filter coefficients} sets the filter coefficients are separable, {Coefficient source} sets the source of filter coefficients Specify via, {Coefficients} sets the filter coefficients {Vertical coefficients (across height)} sets the vertical filter coefficients, {Horizontal coefficients (across height)} sets the horizontal filter coefficients, {Output size} sets the size of filtered, {Pad value source} sets the source of padding value Specify, {Pad value} sets the padding value, {Filtering based on} sets the method of filtering and {Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Separable filter coefficients
params.values: Filter coefficients are separable off (default) | on

params.name: Coefficient source
params.values: Source of filter coefficients Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Output size
params.values: Size of filtered image Full (default) | Same as input port I | Valid

params.name: Padding options
params.values: Padding method Constant (default) | Replicate | Symmetric | Circular

params.name: Pad value source
params.values: Source of padding value Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on
